messages.subject: diffgate #346: 12/12 tasks complete, FINAL pass, archived
messages.body: Amended the plan (3 HIGH and the MEDIUM advisory fixes plus your rulings: read-only dry-run calls in sessions with coordinator S-begin/S-check/S-fixcheck steps, 472-line base c8d80346a96c, inherited src/superclaude line kept), then ran /sc:implement: 12 of 12 tasks have complete compliant ledger lines (T1, T2, T4 needed one fix pass each), the fresh FINAL returned pass and the package is archived at .dev/tasks/done/TASK-WF-spec-20261108-181640. Results: new tests 86 passed; spec-panel, routing and install tests 1395 passed; severity-rule and dual-surface tests 65 passed; make lint All checks passed (Check 6 not triggered, so the Activation ruling did not apply); full suite 24645 passed, 2 failed, both environmental (No module named ruff in the venv for tests/cli/eval/test_claude_process_adapter.py ruff tests), no plan file involved. Not built or not verified: nothing is installed into ~/.claude and the section 5 pre-run gate and S1 runs are not run; recorded non-blocking notes remain (a via anchor on the unchanged words of a line inside another hunk is accepted, an empty .lock file is treated as stale, check and fixcheck test step order outside the lock, after a structural failure a real check is accepted without the extra begin), and briefs/README.md line 13 says 'Both' sentences stay for T07 although T07 has one occurrence.
